title: Shadow: power distribution
spec: Wiring hub · 2 power modules · 5 V 15 A · ISL8117A · dual battery
summary: The power distribution system for Shadow, UBC AeroDesign's 2023–24 Advanced Class aircraft: a wiring hub that carries the Cube Orange flight controller, and two custom 5 V, 15 A power modules with hot-swappable dual batteries and voltage and current sensing. Flown at SAE Aero Design West 2024 in Van Nuys, California.
